title: Enterprise Multi-Tenant SaaS AI Tiered Rate-Limiting (GCRA), Asymmetric I/O Compute Credits & Work-Conserving Burst-Borrowing

tiers.architecture: Fixed 60-second HTTP request counters per tenant (treats 100-token chat equal to 64K-prompt + 8K-reasoning loop; suffers :00 boundary stampedes)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Flat Unweighted Total-Token-Per-Minute (TPM) Hard Cap
tiers.architecture: Counting 1 input token == 1 output token == 1 cached token with hard non-borrowing tenant ceilings

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Local Gateway Token-Bucket Without Pre-Flight Reserve or Cached-Token Discount
tiers.architecture: Per-gateway in-memory token bucket deducting tokens only post-completion (allows concurrent burst overruns before first stream finishes)

tiers.tier: Tier 4: Distributed Redis-Cell GCRA + Asymmetric Weighted Compute-Credit (0.15x/1x/4x) + Work-Conserving Burst-Borrowing Queue
tiers.architecture: Pre-Flight Escrow + Post-Stream Settlement GCRA + Asymmetric Credits (0.15x Cached / 1.0x Uncached In / 4.0x Decode Out) + Idle Cluster Burst-Borrowing

scenarios.scenario: Asymmetric GPU Compute Weighting: 32K Prefix-Cached RAG vs. 8K Long-CoT Decode Loop
scenarios.question: Tenant A sends a 32K RAG query with 30K warm cached prefix tokens + 200 output tokens; Tenant B sends a 1K prompt that generates 8,000 reasoning decode tokens
scenarios.model_answer: Charge asymmetric GPU Compute Credits: C = 0.15 * T_cached + 1.0 * T_uncached_in + 4.0 * T_decode_out -> Tenant A pays 6,500 credits (0.2% false 429), while Tenant B's heavy HBM-bandwidth decode loop pays 33,000 credits
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 flat TPM charges Tenant A 32,200 tokens (falsely throttling cheap cached hits at 19.2%) while under-charging Tenant B's expensive 8K decode loop (9,000 tokens).

scenarios.scenario: Pre-Flight Token Escrow & Post-Stream Actual Settlement (Preventing Concurrent SSE Overruns)
scenarios.question: A Free-tier tenant fires 50 concurrent SSE streaming requests simultaneously across 6 API gateway replicas before any single stream finishes
scenarios.model_answer: Execute atomic Redis-Cell Lua GCRA pre-flight escrow (Prompt_Tokens + P90_Expected_Output_Tokens) at request arrival; refund unused output credits on stream `[DONE]` (0.0% overrun leakage)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 3 deducts tokens only when a stream completes—allowing all 50 concurrent requests to bypass the gate and saturate GPU HBM for 45 seconds (6.2%–16.4% quota overrun).

scenarios.scenario: Eliminating :00 Minute-Boundary Stampedes via Continuous GCRA (Theoretical Arrival Time TAT)
scenarios.question: 340 enterprise batch scripts retry simultaneously at the top of every minute (:00.000), causing periodic GPU queue spikes
scenarios.model_answer: Enforce Generic Cell Rate Algorithm (GCRA) continuous emission intervals (TAT_new = max(t_now, TAT_prev) + Credit_Cost * Emission_Interval) with sub-second pacing headers
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 fixed-window counter allows a 2x double-quota burst across the :59.9s and :00.1s boundary, spiking P99 TTFT to 4,120 ms.

scenarios.scenario: Work-Conserving Opportunistic Burst-Borrowing When Shared GPU Pool Utilization < 75%
scenarios.question: Enterprise Tenant C exceeds its committed 2M credits/min baseline during a product launch while overall GPU cluster utilization is only 58%
scenarios.model_answer: Admit excess requests tagged `qos=Opportunistic_Borrow` into the work-conserving secondary queue as long as cluster KV/compute utilization < 75%; preempt/throttle borrowed traffic instantly if another tenant needs its guaranteed baseline (84.5% cluster utilization)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 hard TPM cap rejects Tenant C with HTTP 429 while 49% of the expensive H100 cluster sits completely idle.

key_findings: Tier 4 (Distributed Redis-Cell GCRA + Asymmetric Weighted Compute-Credit Metering + Pre-Flight Escrow + Work-Conserving Burst-Borrowing) cuts noisy-neighbor P99 TTFT from 4,120 ms to 310 ms (-92.5%) and false HTTP 429 throttling on cached RAG from 24.5% to 0.2%.
Weighting tokens by true GPU Roofline cost (0.15x cached prefix, 1.0x uncached prefill, 4.0x autoregressive decode) aligns tenant quotas with actual HBM bandwidth and Tensor Core consumption.

Combining atomic pre-flight token escrow with opportunistic work-conserving burst-borrowing raises shared GPU cluster utilization from 42.0% to 84.5%, cutting monthly GPU TCO from $165K to $62K (-62.4%).
